question.text: When ethylamine react with sodium metal, the gas evolved is

solution.text:
When ethylamine is heated with sodium metal, then hydrogen gas is evolved. $2 \mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{H}_{5} \mathrm{NH}_{2}+2 \mathrm{Na} \longrightarrow$
$$
2 \mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{H}_{5} \overline{\mathrm{N}} \mathrm{HNa}^{+}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \uparrow
$$
